lines.text: Potiphar, captain of the guard, buys Joseph from the Ishmaelites, and the LORD makes Joseph prosper until he runs the household.
Potiphar's wife tells Joseph to sleep with her, but he refuses day after day, calling it a sin against God.
When Joseph goes into the house and no servants are inside, she grabs his cloak, and he leaves it and runs to the fields.
She tells the servants and then Potiphar that Joseph came to her, and Potiphar burns with grief.
Potiphar has Joseph thrown into the king's prison, where the LORD grants him favor with the warden, who puts all the prisoners in his care.
